svg.title: Quill reads Ember after block 9
svg.desc: One read through the link at one exchange depth, as in pairing/link.py Side.show and Side.read: Quill's position "you" (time 3) attends over every Ember position read at time 3 or earlier plus its null key. Purple parts belong to the reader (Quill), orange parts to the sender (Ember). Bars, gate meters and weights are drawings, not measured values.
